title: SA/2926/1979 of GUMAN SINGH and ANOTHER Vs UDE SINGH and ANOTHER

paras.text:
SA No. 677 of 2001
(Old No. 2926 of 1979)
Hon'ble B.C. Kandpal, J.
(Delay Condonation Application No. 9257 of 2006)
 Heard learned counsel for the appellant
on the delay condonation application and
perused the affidavit filed in support thereto.
 I find sufficient ground to condone the
delay in filing the substitution application.
 Accordingly, the delay condonation
application is allowed.
Application for Setting Aside Abatement No. 9258 of 2006
Substitution Application No. 9259 of 2006
 Heard learned counsel for the appellant
on the substitution application as well as setting
aside abatement application and perused the
affidavit filed in support thereto.
 Substitution application is allowed.
Learned counsel for the appellant is directed to
incorporate the proposed legal heir of appellant
No. 1 in the memo of appeal within a period of
three days.
 Sri V.K. Bist, learned Senior Advocate
appearing on behalf of the appellant.
 Consequently, the application for setting
aside the abatement is also disposed of.
Misc. Application No. 12024 of 2006
 Heard Sri V.K. Bisht, learned Senior
Advocate appearing on behalf for the appellant
and Sri Rajendra Dobhal, learned counsel for
the respondents on the misc. application and
perused the record.
 Miscellaneous application has been filed
by both the parties stating therein that both the
parties have entered into compromise,
therefore, the appeal be decided in terms of the
compromise.
 Having considered the submission
advanced by the learned counsel for the parties,
the appeal is finally disposed of in terms of the
compromise arrived at between the parties.
